text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu. The happy birthday present is, 
believe it or not—a miraculous 
collaboration between Machan and 
Turbo-san—

text_block_list.name: Merchant & Turbo
text_block_list.text:
It's the fluffy-light lunch set♪ A Turbo 
Engine full-throttle bento!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Well, I can tell both of you gave 
it everything you had. —Then let's see 
what you two are capable of!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Her cooking skills... That's right, Hishi 
Ama-san is one of the best cooks in the 
academy...!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Turbo-san, this is an emergency...! With 
the dessert Chan-Ma made, I don't know if 
we can pass the judging~!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Turbo's tamagoyaki isn't as fluffy as 
Hishi Ama's bento either...! I-Is it no 
good after all~~!?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha. No need to worry! Cooking is always 
like that for everyone at first!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Besides, the desire to make someone happy 
is the ultimate seasoning. With that, your 
bentos are guaranteed to be delicious!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
! Turbo made it 'cause I wanted to make 
Hishiama happy! So it's gotta be okay, 
right?!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
I also threw in the octopus sausages that 
Hishi Ama always makes for me! And as a 
special bonus, I gave them 10 legs!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Mar-chan's motivation is fully charged 
too~! Here are four types of roll cakes 
shaped like Mar-chan's face—a true 
masterpiece currently in talks for a 
collab menu.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, nice! It's packed to the brim with 
the ultimate seasoning. Down the hatch, 
thanks!
